notes_for_owner: Added in the family plan's Phase 5. The catalog entry is written from formskills' README and tauri.conf.json (identifier ai.nodemode.formskills, owner's Q5; the old id formskill is retired in FormPortal and FormRanker). formskills is a Cargo workspace like formtray; build_app and build_app.bat follow formtray's, and ./build_app --no-install --bundles deb was run on Linux (formskills_0.4.0_amd64.deb with the binary, LICENSE, NOTICE.md, the desktop file and icons). It ships no skills of its own and no MCP server: it shows the other apps' skills. build_app makes the macOS disk image with hdiutil; formcompiler signs and notarizes it after the build (v0.6.0).
